agentUI.请先连接 Gateway，再使用工作流助手。: Connect to a Gateway to use the assistant.
agentUI.可以创建会话、导入工作流和查看已保存版本。管理员配置模型后，即可开始对话。: You can create chats, import workflows and view saved versions. Chat becomes available when a model is configured.
agentUI.你想创作什么？: What would you like to create?

agentUI.仅支持图片、视频和音频: Only images, video and audio are supported

agentUI.助手已停止；已提交的生成可能继续运行: Assistant stopped; submitted generation may continue

agentUI.当前 Gateway 尚未启用工作流助手: The assistant is not enabled on this Gateway

agentUI.请先在 Gateway 配置 LLM provider: Configure an LLM provider on the Gateway first.

agentUI.请读取当前版本再执行: Reload the current version before running.
agentUI.模型未返回要求的操作或完成确认，请重试当前请求: The model did not return the required action or completion confirmation. Retry the request.
agentUI.模型没有返回有效回答: The model did not return a valid response.
agentUI.模型或 ComfyUI 请求失败，请检查 Gateway 配置与连接后重试: The model or ComfyUI request failed. Check the Gateway configuration and connection, then retry.
agentUI.工作流暂不支持或存在错误: The workflow is unsupported or contains errors.
agentUI.只删除对话记录和版本历史，工作流库里的工作流会保留。: Only the chat history and version history are deleted; the workflow stays in your library.
agentUI.离开页面后，后台任务继续运行。: Background tasks keep running after you leave this page.
agentUI.助手尚未连接语言模型，管理员配置后即可开始对话。: The assistant isn't connected to a language model yet. Once an administrator configures one, you can start chatting.
agentUI.暂时无法连接助手。: The assistant is unreachable right now.
agentUI.助手需要通过 Gateway 连接: The assistant needs a Gateway connection
agentUI.等待管理员配置语言模型: Waiting for an administrator to configure a language model
agentUI.暂时无法连接助手: The assistant is unreachable right now
agentUI.你现在直连的是 ComfyUI。对话助手运行在 Comfy Mobile Gat: You're connected directly to ComfyUI. The chat assistant runs on Comfy Mobile Gateway, where it interprets your request, edits workflows, and waits for generations in the background. Your workflow library and gallery are unaffected and work as usual.
agentUI.Gateway 已连接，但还没有配置语言模型。管理员在 Gateway 的 .e: Gateway is connected, but no language model is configured yet. Once an administrator fills in AGENT_LLM_* in the Gateway's .env, you can start chatting here.
agentUI.已连接 Gateway，但助手接口没有响应。可能是 Gateway 未启用助手或: Gateway is connected, but the assistant endpoint isn't responding. The assistant may be disabled on the Gateway, or the Gateway may be restarting.
agentUI.在服务器上部署 Gateway，并在其配置里启用助手和语言模型: Deploy Gateway on your server and enable the assistant and a language model in its configuration
agentUI.在连接设置里把服务器地址改为 Gateway 地址并登录: In connection settings, change the server address to the Gateway address and sign in
agentUI.配置用于对话和上下文压缩的语言模型。切换模型从下一条消息生效，所有设备共享配置。: Configure the language model for chat and context summaries. Changes apply to the next message and are shared across devices.
agentUI.Gateway 已连接，添加语言模型后即可开始对话。: Gateway is connected. Add a language model to start chatting.
agentUI.使用兼容 OpenAI Chat Completions 的 API 地址，通常: Use an OpenAI Chat Completions compatible API base URL, usually ending in /v1.
agentUI.已保存，留空保留原密钥: Saved; leave blank to keep the current key
agentUI.无需鉴权的服务可留空: Leave blank for services without authentication
agentUI.密钥仅保存在 Gateway，不会回传到 App。更改 API 地址时需重新填写: Keys stay on the Gateway and are never returned to the App. Re-enter the key when changing the API URL.
agentUI.按模型实际能力填写。接近上下文预算时自动摘要较早内容，保留近期消息与完整聊天记录: Enter the model's actual limits. Older context is summarized automatically as the budget fills; recent messages and the full chat transcript are retained. Output is limited to one quarter of the window.
agentUI.关闭后仅发送附件路径，不向语言模型发送图片。: When off, only attachment paths are sent; images are not sent to the language model.
agentUI.当前模型仅接收图片路径；如需理解图片内容，请选择支持 Vision 的模型。: This model receives image paths only. Select a vision model to understand image content.
agentUI.删除此模型配置及密钥，聊天记录会保留。: Delete this model configuration and key. Chat history will be kept.
agentUI.已压缩较早上下文，完整聊天记录仍保留: Older context summarized; full chat history retained
agentUI.请先在 App 中配置助手模型: Configure an assistant model in the App first
agentUI.该模型有运行中的任务，请先等待或停止任务: This model has active tasks. Wait for them to finish or stop them first.
agentUI.最多保存 30 个模型: You can save up to 30 models
agentUI.更改 API 地址时请重新填写密钥: Re-enter the key when changing the API URL
agentUI.模型上下文不足以容纳工作流和工具，请增大上下文窗口或降低输出上限: The workflow and tools exceed the context budget. Increase the context window or lower the output limit.
agentUI.当前消息或附件超出模型上下文，请缩短消息、减少图片或增大上下文窗口: The message or attachments exceed the context budget. Shorten the message, use fewer images, or increase the window.
agentUI.历史记录过大，压缩未完成；请增大模型上下文窗口后重试: History is too large to finish summarizing. Increase the context window and retry.
agentUI.上下文压缩失败，模型未返回摘要，请重试: Context summarization failed: the model returned no summary. Retry.
agentUI.模型返回的摘要过长，请检查模型输出上限后重试: The summary is too long. Check the model output limit and retry.
agentUI.压缩后上下文仍然过大，请增大模型上下文窗口: The summarized context is still too large. Increase the context window.
agentUI.模型上下文超限，自动压缩后仍无法继续；请检查模型上下文大小或减少图片: The model still rejects the context after compaction. Check the context window or use fewer images.
agentUI.「{{name}}」已从服务器删除，可以保存为新工作流。: “{{name}}” was deleted from the server. You can save this as a new workflow.
agentUI.「{{name}}」已被其他设备修改。为避免覆盖，这里只能另存为新工作流。: “{{name}}” was changed on another device. To avoid overwriting it, you can only save as a new workflow here.
agentUI.另一设备正在保存这个对话，请稍后再试。: Another device is saving this chat. Try again in a moment.
agentUI.另存为新工作流: Save a copy as new workflow
agentUI.同名工作流已存在，请换一个名称: A workflow with this name already exists; choose another name
agentUI.已与「{{name}}」一致，无需再次保存。: Already identical to “{{name}}”; nothing to save.
agentUI.更新会影响以后使用「{{name}}」开始的对话；已经开始的对话仍使用各自的草稿: Updating affects chats started from “{{name}}” in the future; chats already started keep their own drafts.
agentUI.未能保存到工作流库，草稿已保留: Could not save to the library; the draft is kept
agentUI.直接描述目标。助手会根据已安装的模型选择合适的工作流并生成预览；满意后再保存到工: Describe what you want. The assistant picks a workflow for your installed models and generates a preview; save it to the library once you are happy.
agentUI.草稿有新修改（版本 {{version}} 已保存到「{{name}}」）: Draft has new changes (version {{version}} saved to “{{name}}”)
